name: Stormbringer: Titanstorm reduces the cast rank only on Call Lightning and Electrocute (#686)
contract: Titanstorm 801869 (Spell.dbc: passive, Effect[0] APPLY_AURA / aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectTriggerSpell 801854) promises "Casting Call Lightning or Electrocute now reduces the cooldown of Arm of Thorim and Lightning Cage by $/1000;801854S1 sec". 801854 carries two SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN effects with EffectBasePoints -1501 + EffectDieSides 1 = -1500 ms, EffectMiscValue[0] 801847 Arm of Thorim and EffectMiscValue[1] 560030 Lightning Cage. Two defects are covered here. First, 801869's DBC ProcFlags 327680 (DONE_SPELL_MAGIC_DMG_CLASS_NEG | DONE_PERIODIC) make SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs generate an entry whose SpellFamilyName is 0, so no spell filter applies and any negative magic spell reduces both cooldowns; Shock 504634 (SpellFamilyFlags0 0x800, outside the talent's Electrocute 0x2000000 and Call Lightning 0x10 masks) is the probe for that. Second, Player::ModifySpellCooldown keys the cooldown map by the exact EffectMiscValue id, so naming rank 1 (801847) leaves the rank a level-80 player casts untouched: Arm of Thorim is a 9-rank chain (spell_ranks first_spell_id 801847, rank 9 = 567520) with Category 981 and RecoveryTime/CategoryRecoveryTime 20000, while Lightning Cage is a single rank with RecoveryTime 180000 and is reduced correctly today. An identical unarmed control player casts the same spells in lockstep, so every assertion on the armed player is a difference against the control's cooldown at the same instant and ordinary decay cancels out.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Titanstorm is passive (Attributes 464) and self-applies on learn
SETUP: the control never learns Titanstorm
SETUP: Arm of Thorim rank 9 runs its 20000 ms RecoveryTime
SETUP: Lightning Cage runs its 180000 ms RecoveryTime
SETUP: Category 981 also stores the cooldown under rank 1 (801847), which the tooltip names
SETUP: both players start from the same Arm of Thorim rank 9 cooldown
SETUP: both players start from the same Lightning Cage cooldown
SETUP: both players start from the same Arm of Thorim rank 1 entry
BASELINE: Call Lightning takes 1500 ms off Lightning Cage (801854 -1501 + 1 die side), which already works
DISCRIMINATING: the 1500 ms lands on Arm of Thorim rank 9, the rank a level-80 player casts
BASELINE: the rank 1 entry named by EffectMiscValue[0] also loses 1500 ms
BASELINE: Electrocute is the tooltip's second source, so Lightning Cage is now 3000 ms shorter in total
DISCRIMINATING: Arm of Thorim rank 9 is 3000 ms shorter in total after Call Lightning and Electrocute
SETUP: the Shock cast really landed, so the next assertions are not a silent no-cast
DISCRIMINATING: Shock is outside the talent's family masks, so Lightning Cage stays at the same 3000 ms total
DISCRIMINATING: Shock leaves Arm of Thorim rank 9 at the same 3000 ms total
DISCRIMINATING: Shock leaves the rank 1 entry at the same 3000 ms total
